note: FDXR variants frequently cause severe rod-cone retinal dystrophy alongside optic neuropathy, distinguishing it from pure optic neuropathies, although reported penetrance in cohorts is high but not strictly 100%.

evidence.text: In a cohort of five patients with biallelic FDXR variants, all 5 presented with retinal dystrophy, and electroretinography revealed severely impaired cone and rod photoreceptor function in the first decade.

source.title: FDXR-associated disease in a Chinese cohort: Unraveling expanded ocular phenotypes and genetic spectrum
source.quote: In addition to optic atrophy and diverse extraocular manifestations, all patients presented with retinal dystrophy, and electroretinogram showed severely impaired cone and rod functions in their first decades.

numbers.metric: affected patients with rod-cone ERG impairment

evidence.text: In a cohort of 10 individuals with biallelic FDXR variants, 7 out of 10 manifested rod and cone photoreceptor dysfunction and degeneration, indicating high frequency but not complete 100% penetrance across all affected individuals.

source.title: Expanding the FDXR-Associated Disease Phenotype: Retinal ...
source.quote: In addition to bilateral optic atrophy and variable extra-ocular findings, 7 of 10 individuals manifested retinal dystrophy comprising dysfunction and degeneration of both rod and cone photoreceptors.
